# Cancellation records intent, cancels unbound nodes and asks the bound job to
# stop; the CLI does not wait for it. Every task field survives acceptance and
# cancellation exactly as the literal expected graph states it: placement,
# retry, requests and limits, workdir, setup, outputs, and mounts with
# read_only false and true. Mounts need --remote-data. Only the first node
# ever runs.
private-workdir
skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
skygo auth principal add alice --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth principal add bob --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice.token --expires-in 24h
skygo auth token issue bob --auth-file $AUTH --output bob.token --expires-in 24h
server start
skygo --token-file alice.token artifacts upload source
cp stdout seed.json
graph-file cancel.tmpl cancel.yaml seed.json
graph-file cancel-graph.tmpl cancel-graph.json seed.json
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow run --remote-data -f cancel.yaml --request-id cancel
json-field id WF
cp stdout accepted.json
same-graph cancel-graph.json accepted.json
await-file ready-first
await-workflow alice.token $WF first running
event-count 1

! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow cancel $WF
stderr '^cancellation requires --yes\n$'
calls WorkflowService/CancelWorkflow 0
! skygo --token-file bob.token workflow cancel $WF --yes
stderr '^not_found: '
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow cancel $WF --yes
stdout '"cancel_requested": *true'
calls WorkflowService/CancelWorkflow 2
await-workflow alice.token $WF first canceled
await-workflow alice.token $WF second canceled
await-workflow alice.token $WF produce canceled
await-workflow alice.token $WF consume canceled
cp stdout canceled.json
json-field nodes.0.job_id FIRST
! json-field nodes.1.job_id JOB
! json-field nodes.2.job_id JOB
! json-field nodes.3.job_id JOB
same-graph cancel-graph.json canceled.json
event-count 1
! exists done-first
! exists done-second

# Repeating cancellation changes nothing.
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow cancel $WF --yes
cmp stdout canceled.json
skygo --token-file alice.token workflow get $WF
stdout '^'$WF'\tcancel-requested=true\n'
stdout '(?m)^first +pending +'$FIRST' +canceled$'
stdout '(?m)^second +canceled +- +-$'
calls job-submissions 0
server stop
! stderr .

-- source/seed.txt --
seed
-- cancel.tmpl --
nodes:
- name: first
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: hold, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: first}
- name: second
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: succeed, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: second}
    directory: /srv/work
    image: example.invalid/workload:1
    accelerator: example-accelerator
    accelerator_count: 2
    target: local
    timeout_seconds: 60
    target_labels: {zone: a}
    node_selector: {pool: b}
    retry: {max_attempts: 3, delay_seconds: 5, exit_codes: [2, 7]}
  depends_on: [first]
- name: produce
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: produce, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: produce}
    workdir: {id: "@REF_ID@", sha256: "@REF_SHA256@", size: @REF_SIZE@}
    setup: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$", "--", "setup"]
    outputs: [out]
    cpu_millis: 250
    memory_bytes: 33554432
    cpu_limit_millis: 500
    memory_limit_bytes: 67108864
  depends_on: [first]
- name: consume
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: consume, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: consume}
    setup: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$", "--", "setup"]
    outputs: [result]
    data_mounts:
    - {reference: corpus, destination: /mnt/skygo/corpus, read_only: false}
    - {reference: models, destination: /mnt/skygo/models, read_only: true}
  depends_on: [produce]
  input: {node: produce, slot: result}
